text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Track 2 experimental portfolio: three roles, not a ranking

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 8px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: No overall score, no winner. Each intervention is informative by failing, and a different hypothesis dies in each case.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Built from research/track2_candidates.tsv: 3 interventions, 3 controls, 30 claim cells, 12 carrying a published identifier.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Colour encodes PROVENANCE, not efficacy or support: a green cell means the claim carries a published identifier, not that it favours the arm.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Vehicle is the only true negative control; sirolimus is an adversarial comparator, not a negative control. · NONE of these is proposed for administration.
